title: Hearty Stew
description: A comforting stew with a mix of tender cabbage and rich beef, perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the stew beef, then set aside.
Add more oil if needed, then cook the chopped cabbage until tender.
Return the browned beef to the pot, stirring to combine.
Add soy sauce, berbere spice, salt, and pepper; stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1.5 hours.
Check the beef for tenderness, then serve hot.
